assets.name: library
assets.prompt: Create ONE standalone mobile UI icon on a genuinely transparent alpha background, square canvas. Use the supplied app logo solely as STYLE REFERENCE. Match its tactile cut-paper/gouache look, rounded handmade silhouettes, thick very dark green outlines, evergreen and jade green, warm cream paper, tiny golden yellow/coral accents. NOT glossy 3D, no gradient tile, no enclosing app squircle, no text, no letters, no watermark, no background shadow. Simplify heavily for crisp legibility at 32dp: bold large masses, very few details, no fine hatching, minimal subtle paper texture. Center subject taking 78 percent of width and height with even transparent padding. All outlines closed and smooth. Palette and visual weight should form one coherent icon family with the reference. Subject: An open cream-page book with two rounded dark evergreen covers and a small golden star centered above the book. Extremely clear compact silhouette; only one page fold per side. Represents a personal reading library.
